menu_options.pick_device: Lamp via Bluetooth (adapter or Bluetooth proxy)
menu_options.account: Luke Roberts account (all lamps, cloud fallback)

bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up {name}? Home Assistant will control it locally through your Bluetooth adapters and proxies.

pick_device.title: Select the lamp
pick_device.description: Pick a lamp seen by any Bluetooth adapter or proxy, or enter its Bluetooth address.

account.title: Luke Roberts account
account.description: Sign in once, like the Luke Roberts app. Create a personal API key at {cloud_url} and paste it here. Bluetooth lamps are then linked to the cloud automatically and lamps out of Bluetooth range are offered as discovered devices.

account_lamp_confirm.description: Add {name} from your Luke Roberts account? It will be controlled through the cloud. If the lamp is also in Bluetooth range, ignore this and set it up via Bluetooth instead; it is linked to the account automatically.

reauth_confirm.title: New API key
reauth_confirm.description: The Luke Roberts cloud rejected the stored API key.

error.invalid_address: This is not a valid Bluetooth address.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Luke Roberts cloud.
error.no_lamps: No lamps were found in this account.

abort.account_configured: The Luke Roberts account is already set up.

init.title: Options
init.description: Bluetooth is local and fast. With the Luke Roberts account (or an API key just for this lamp) the lamp stays reachable when no adapter or proxy is in range.

data.linger: Keep Bluetooth connection after the last command

data_description.linger: While connected the Luke Roberts app shows the lamp as in use. 0 disconnects right after each command.
data_description.api_key: Only needed when this lamp should use a different key than the Luke Roberts account. Personal API keys are created at {cloud_url}.
data_description.firmware_key: Api-Key for the Luke Roberts firmware server. With it the firmware entity shows whether a newer version is available.
data_description.power_entity: A light or switch that switches the lamp's power, for example a KNX actuator or a smart plug. On/off then switches the power; brightness, colour temperature and scenes still go over Bluetooth. Leave empty to switch the lamp off with its Off scene.

connection.title: Connection
connection.description: Bluetooth is local and fast. With the Luke Roberts account (or an API key just for this lamp) the lamp stays reachable when no adapter or proxy is in range.

data.linger: Keep Bluetooth connection after the last command

data_description.linger: While connected the Luke Roberts app shows the lamp as in use. 0 disconnects right after each command.
data_description.api_key: Only needed when this lamp should use a different key than the Luke Roberts account. Personal API keys are created at {cloud_url}.
data_description.firmware_key: Api-Key for the Luke Roberts firmware server. With it the firmware entity shows whether a newer version is available.
data_description.power_entity: A light or switch that switches the lamp's power, for example a KNX actuator or a smart plug. On/off then switches the power; brightness, colour temperature and scenes still go over Bluetooth. Leave empty to switch the lamp off with its Off scene.

scenes.title: Manage scenes
scenes.description: The scenes stored in the lamp are read once and kept in Home Assistant. Through a Bluetooth proxy this can take up to a minute.

scene_pick.title: Manage scenes
scene_pick.description: Choose a scene stored in the lamp. Off and animated scenes cannot be changed.

scene_rename.title: Rename scene
scene_rename.description: A backup of all scenes is made first.

data_description.name: At most 20 bytes; letters like é count twice.

scene_duplicate.title: Duplicate scene
scene_duplicate.description: The copy goes to a free slot and the lamp switches to it, as in the app.

scene_edit.title: Edit {scene}
scene_edit.description: Only what you change is applied; the scene's pattern is kept. A backup of all scenes is made first.

data_description.uplight_white: On: the uplight uses the colour temperature below instead of a colour.
data_description.uplight_brightness: Brightness of the brightest segment; the others follow.
data_description.downlight_brightness: Brightness of the brightest spot; the others follow.

scene_restore.title: Restore {scene}
scene_restore.description: Write {scene} back as it was in the newest backup that differs from the lamp.

scene_delete.title: Delete {scene}
scene_delete.description: Delete {scene} from the lamp? Home Assistant created this scene. A backup of all scenes is made first.

error.api_key_required: This connection mode needs a cloud API key.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Luke Roberts cloud.
error.no_lamps: No lamps were found in this account.
error.invalid_scene_name: The name is empty or longer than 20 bytes.

abort.scenes_need_bluetooth: Scenes can only be managed over Bluetooth while the lamp is set up.
abort.no_static_scenes: The lamp has no scene that can be changed.
abort.scene_restored: {scene} was restored from the backup of {time}.

immediate_light.name: Immediate light
immediate_light.description: Temporarily change the uplight colour and/or downlight of the current scene (Bluetooth only). Lost when another scene is selected.

uplight_kelvin.name: Uplight colour temperature
uplight_kelvin.description: White uplight instead of a colour.

downlight_kelvin.name: Downlight colour temperature
downlight_kelvin.description: Colour temperature of the direct light.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Revert to the scene after this time (max 65 s). 0 keeps it.

backup_scenes.name: Back up scenes
backup_scenes.description: Read every scene stored in the lamp (Bluetooth only) and keep a backup in Home Assistant. Returns the scene ids and names.

rename_scene.name: Rename scene
rename_scene.description: Give a scene stored in the lamp another name (Bluetooth only). Everything else stays the same, and a backup of all scenes is made first. Dynamic scenes and Off cannot be renamed.

scene.name: Scene
scene.description: Name or id of the scene.

restore_scene.name: Restore scene
restore_scene.description: Write a scene back as it was in the newest backup that differs from the lamp (Bluetooth only). A backup is made first.

scene.name: Scene
scene.description: Name or id of the scene.

duplicate_scene.name: Duplicate scene
duplicate_scene.description: Copy a static scene stored in the lamp into a free slot under a new name (Bluetooth only). A backup of all scenes is made first. Like in the app, the lamp switches to the new scene. Returns the new scene id.

scene.name: Scene
scene.description: Name or id of the scene to copy.

delete_scene.name: Delete scene
delete_scene.description: Delete a scene that Home Assistant created with Duplicate scene (Bluetooth only). Scenes made in the Luke Roberts app are never deleted. A backup of all scenes is made first.

scene.name: Scene
scene.description: Name or id of the scene.

edit_scene.name: Edit scene
edit_scene.description: Change the colours and brightness of a static scene stored in the lamp (Bluetooth only). Only the given values change; brightness scales the scene's pattern so its brightest part gets the value. A backup of all scenes is made first.

scene.name: Scene
scene.description: Name or id of the scene.

uplight_kelvin.name: Uplight colour temperature
uplight_kelvin.description: White uplight instead of a colour.

uplight_brightness.name: Uplight brightness
uplight_brightness.description: Brightness of the brightest uplight segment.

downlight_kelvin.name: Downlight colour temperature
downlight_kelvin.description: Colour temperature of the direct light.

downlight_brightness.name: Downlight brightness
downlight_brightness.description: Brightness of the brightest downlight spot.

preview_scene.name: Preview scene
preview_scene.description: Show a static scene stored in the lamp, optionally with changed colours and brightness, without saving it (Bluetooth only). Takes the same fields as Edit scene. The lamp shows it until a scene is selected; try a change here first, then save it with Edit scene.

scene.name: Scene
scene.description: Name or id of the scene.

uplight_kelvin.name: Uplight colour temperature
uplight_kelvin.description: White uplight instead of a colour.

uplight_brightness.name: Uplight brightness
uplight_brightness.description: Brightness of the brightest uplight segment.

downlight_kelvin.name: Downlight colour temperature
downlight_kelvin.description: Colour temperature of the direct light.

downlight_brightness.name: Downlight brightness
downlight_brightness.description: Brightness of the brightest downlight spot.

no_power.message: {name}: the lamp has no power; switch it on first.

no_answer_after_power_on.message: {name}: the lamp did not answer over Bluetooth within {seconds} s after switching the power on ({error}).
